summary:
Five bounded integration fixes on the current APPLIED sources; nothing else touched (no stats, no docs, no board/DMA/kernel/RTL).

(1) tests/board-p4m-formal60.sh resume_preflight called startup_max_seq with one positional argument while the shared helper reads $2 (awk -v id="$2"), so set -u aborted with '...guard-harness.sh: 20: 2: parameter not set' and the case-check then reported startup_max_seq_unreadable. The call now passes the text id "resume35" and checks the helper exit status before the digit check; the helper API and locate_new_startup are untouched (byte-identical).

(2) tests/test_p4m_formal60_recovery.py Formal60PlanTest scanned the whole runner, so the 11 resume35 triplets (b10..b20) leaked into the plan assertion (attached ring-integration.log: 11 extra elements, first extra (10, 0, 2000, 1000)). The test now extracts the production run_formal_block body with the existing _extract_shell_function helper and regexes only that body; EXPECTED_FORMAL_BLOCKS (20 original triplets) is unchanged.

(3) The formal60 provenance header claimed 'No resume parameters, no matrix changes', which became false when resume35 was added. It now states that the frozen formal60 matrix and all existing modes are unchanged and that the only later addition is the explicit resume35 continuation (frozen flat cases 26..60 behind a read-only seq37 preflight). Checked both headers for a stale total-count+1 assumption: the per-trial verification bullets in tests/board-p4m-formal60.sh (lines 73-77) and tests/board-p4m-start.sh (lines 56-59) already describe 'seq strictly greater than the maximum seq seen before / counted-but-reused seq refused', i.e. the current method, so no stale comment existed and tests/board-p4m-start.sh needed no edit. The only surviving 'total-count+1' phrase is the historically accurate provenance sentence describing the fix itself.

(4) out/p4m-formal60-recovery-20260920/offline_revalidate.py: all_passed no longer ignores per-trial exit/capture/payload state and the PLAN fallback is removed. run.json, PLAN.json and trial_summary.json are now required inputs; trial records must be exactly the 25 PLAN-prefix records with index 0..24, case_exit 0 and capture complete; each archived payload must report success=true, error=null, errno=0, run_attempted=true; archived <case>.err and <case>.dmesg.err must be present and empty; the original runtime metadata is checked (runner_exit 5, cases 24/25/35, failed_case formal-b09-g2000, taints 0, path_observe Y, observed_kernel 6.5.0-rc2-00089-gefd9461d6459, rebooted/bit_reloaded false, plan PLAN.json, status prefix stopped_runner_verification_exit5) in a separate global_metadata_validation block whose passed flag feeds all_passed; per-trial result.status/data_errors/quarantined stay covered by the existing production check_case_json; evidence-tree sha256 and per-input-file sha256 are taken before and after (missing/changed => rc 1); audit.json must be written outside the evidence tree and its sha256 is printed. original_run is passed through verbatim (status never overwritten) and the summary is labelled offline (live_board_rerun=false), so no claim of 25 live-passed trials is made. Cycle/transfer bounds (4096/256, a_did 11) and the extracted production functions are unchanged.

(5) tests/test_p4m_formal60_resume.py keeps the stubbed unit guard (now passing once (1) is applied) and adds Resume35ArchivedPreflightTest: it copies the archived params.txt / formal-b09-g2000.json / formal-b09-g2000.dmesg.raw into a temp tree (originals only read), uses the real extracted production sequence/preflight/verify/json functions with an env-gated archive (P4M_FORMAL60_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE), runs under BusyBox ash+awk when /usr/bin/busybox exists (sh fallback), asserts rc 0 + resume35_preflight=ok + anchor_seq=37 + exact kernel, and asserts the harness contains no idma_experiment/platform-timeout (guard only, no DMA). Taint/path_observe gates live outside resume_preflight and are left to the existing tests; the test skips when the archive or its params/json/dmesg files are absent.

Everything below is proposed code for Codex to apply and verify; the attached logs pre-date these edits and no test was executed here.

class Resume35ArchivedPreflightTest(unittest.TestCase):
    '''Real production-function resume35 preflight against archived evidence.

    The unit guard above isolates resume_preflight with stubbed verify
    functions. This class keeps the same read-only, no-DMA property but drives
    the real production sequence/preflight/verify functions against an isolated
    copy of the archived seq37 boundary (P4M_FORMAL60_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE). The
    taint and path_observe gates live outside resume_preflight and stay covered
    by the existing tests; no board command, device or DMA call is made here.
    '''

    REAL_FUNCTIONS = (
        'unquote',
        'json_get',
        'json_check',
        'check_case_json',
        'dmget',
        'int_of',
        'startup_max_seq',
        'startup_seq',
        'locate_new_startup',
        'locate_new_batch_time',
        'verify_startup',
        'verify_batch_time',
        'extract_resume_seq37',
        'resume_check_seq37_record',
        'resume_preflight',
    )

    ARCHIVED_FILES = (
        'params.txt',
        'formal-b09-g2000.json',
        'formal-b09-g2000.dmesg.raw',
    )

    def setUp(self):
        self._temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='idma-p4m-resume35-archive-')
        self.temp = Path(self._temporary.name)
        self.out = self.temp / 'out'
        self.out.mkdir()
        self.old = self.temp / 'old-run'
        self.old.mkdir()

    def tearDown(self):
        self._temporary.cleanup()

    def _archived_dir(self):
        evidence = os.environ.get(ARCHIVE_ENV)
        if not evidence:
            self.skipTest('%s not set' % ARCHIVE_ENV)
        root = Path(evidence)
        if not all((root / name).is_file() for name in self.ARCHIVED_FILES):
            self.skipTest('archived seq37 evidence not present under %s' % root)
        return root

    def _copy_isolated_inputs(self, root):
        '''Copy the archived inputs into the temp tree; originals are only read.'''
        shutil.copyfile(root / 'params.txt', self.old / 'params.txt')
        shutil.copyfile(root / 'formal-b09-g2000.json', self.old / 'formal-b09-g2000.json')
        shutil.copyfile(root / 'formal-b09-g2000.dmesg.raw',
                        self.old / 'formal-b09-g2000.dmesg.raw')
        current = self.temp / 'current.dmesg'
        shutil.copyfile(root / 'formal-b09-g2000.dmesg.raw', current)
        return current

    def _harness(self, current_dmesg):
        text = SCRIPT.read_text()
        parts = [
            '#!/bin/sh\n',
            'set -u\n',
            'OUT="%s"\n' % self.out,
            'RESUME_ORIGINAL="%s"\n' % self.old,
            'RESUME_ORIGINAL_ID=p4m-formal60-215406\n',
            'RESUME_ORIGINAL_CASE=formal-b09-g2000\n',
            'RESUME_ANCHOR_SEQ=37\n',
            'RESUME_ANCHOR_A_BEGIN_NS=%s\n' % ANCHOR_A_BEGIN_NS,
            'KERNEL_RESUME_MATCH=00089\n',
            'KERNEL_RESUME_EXACT=%s\n' % EXACT_KERNEL,
            'LONG_TRANSFERS=4096\n',
            'A_DID=11\n',
            'V_DID=10\n',
            'kernel_release=%s\n' % EXACT_KERNEL,
            'RESUME_TEST_DMESG="%s"\n' % current_dmesg,
            'dmesg() { cat "$RESUME_TEST_DMESG"; }\n',
        ]
        for name in self.REAL_FUNCTIONS:
            parts.append(_extract_shell_function(text, name))
        parts.append('resume_preflight\n')
        parts.append('echo preflight_rc=$?\n')
        harness = self.temp / 'archived-preflight-harness.sh'
        harness.write_text(''.join(parts))
        return harness

    def _run(self, harness):
        env = os.environ.copy()
        if BUSYBOX.is_file():
            bin_dir = self.temp / 'bin'
            bin_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            awk = bin_dir / 'awk'
            awk.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nexec %s awk "$@"\n' % BUSYBOX)
            awk.chmod(0o755)
            env['PATH'] = str(bin_dir) + ':' + env.get('PATH', '')
            return subprocess.run([str(BUSYBOX), 'ash', str(harness)], text=True,
                                  capture_output=True, check=False, env=env)
        return subprocess.run(['sh', str(harness)], text=True,
                              capture_output=True, check=False, env=env)

    def test_real_archived_seq37_preflight_passes(self):
        root = self._archived_dir()
        current = self._copy_isolated_inputs(root)
        harness = self._harness(current)
        harness_text = harness.read_text()
        self.assertNotIn('idma_experiment', harness_text)
        self.assertNotIn('platform-timeout', harness_text)
        result = self._run(harness)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('preflight_rc=0', result.stdout, result.stderr)
        metadata = (self.out / 'resume35-preflight.txt').read_text()
        self.assertIn('resume35_preflight=ok', metadata)
        self.assertIn('anchor_seq=37', metadata)
        self.assertIn(EXACT_KERNEL, metadata)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
